svg.title: TOPAK B5 — Promotion is a quorum grant, run as a round
svg.desc: ADR-0024 replaces the single promotion signing key, the last privileged human grant. Everything that crosses from Build to Run (boundary B1) is promoted by a round keyed by artifact digest: gates enable voting, grant seats vote, veto seats can only deny, the author is recused, and the tally reads its quorum from the issued rules.
svg.text: TOPAK · B5

text.tspan: Promotion is a quorum grant, run as a round

svg.text: ADR-0024 replaces the single promotion signing key, the last privileged human grant. Everything that crosses from Build to Run (boundary B1) is promoted by a round keyed by artifact digest: gates enable voting, grant seats vote, veto seats can only deny, the author is recused, and the tally reads its quorum from the issued rules.

text.tspan: Issued rules at rules epoch e (anchor issuance, ADR-0025 §1 (a))

svg.text: The promotion roster and its parameters: grantSeats, vetoSeats, quorum ("all" or a threshold k) and minGrant, bounded by the rules floor (R1 unanimity, R2 minGrant ≥ 2, R5 no anchor key on the roster, R9 quorum = "all" ∨ quorum ≥ 2). This quorum cannot change its own rules (§2).
Drafts the artifact in its round workspace.
Ends with Submit(digest), or abstains with
Submit of ⊥ (ADR-0022 §1).
Holds no seat for its own artifact.

text.tspan: Gates enable voting; they do not vote

svg.text: ADR-0007 totality, non-vacuity and discrimination
gates.
bundle ⊑ floor (ADR-0010; listed in §4). By
ADR-0030 composition it holds for every bundle, so
ToO §7.1 says it no longer needs checking here.
Vote is enabled only after the gates pass.
Alphabet Vote(grant), Vote(deny).
Under "all", any grant-seat deny or abstention is a denial; under unanimity every seat is a veto.
Voters are principals on every custody rung, because the anchor can evict them.

text.tspan: Veto seats · every cell Observer and every correlator in Build

svg.text: Alphabet Vote(deny) only: a seat whose alphabet lacks grant. Never an agent in the author's fault domain. A2.1 replaced
"the independent Observer replicated group (ADR-0008)".
A veto-seat deny is a denial; veto-seat silence is not. A "no finding" attestation would make semantic judgment an
enabling condition (ADR-0007).
Removed from the counted seats, and the ADR-0022 Vote envelope refuses its vote: no issuance can admit one.
ADR-0024 enabling condition with A2; every conjunct must hold
G = grantSeats \ {Author(a)}: recusal is a mechanism constant, not an issued value (§6)
|G| ≥ minGrant, else denied (R2)
quorum = "all": every counted grant seat granted (archetype, R1); otherwise |Granted| ≥ k with k ≥ 2 (R9)
A vote counts only as the triple ⟨grant, digest, evidence, rulesEpoch⟩; only recorded votes count
No veto seat has cast ⟨deny, digest, evidence, rulesEpoch⟩
A2.2 a veto seat with a Persona independent of the author's (ADR-0035 §5) was leased for the round, else stalls
A2.3 the author's cell Observer reported coverage to the seal of the author's round (ADR-0039 §3), else stalls
The veto check is any-of over the veto roster: one deny suffices, and adding veto seats never lowers safety
A rules change needs an anchor issuance plus a promotion (ADR-0026 §4): this quorum cannot change its own
One signed artifact crosses B1 into Run.
No strict subset of grant seats can promote (at "all").
A grant-seat deny or abstention; a veto-seat deny; recusal
leaves fewer seats than minGrant.
A timeout is never a grant: a mechanism constant (ex-R4).
No independent veto seat leased (A2.2), or no coverage to the
seal (A2.3): an absent Observer stalls promotion instead of
vetoing nothing.
Submit(digest)
Vote enabled
votes
roster at epoch e
quorum, minGrant
new epoch voids in-flight votes
A vote binds to (artifact digest, gate-evidence digest, rules epoch) (§3).
Any rules-epoch change voids in-flight votes: fencing, the same shape as leases. A vote on other evidence or an older epoch is not in Granted.
Vote(verdict, digest, evidence, rulesEpoch): seat held at rulesEpoch; grant only from a grant seat; terminal for the voter's round (ADR-0022
The authoritative vote is the admit decision in the consensus log (ADR-0015), retained as ADR-0028 F3.
A voter's round-topic emission carries the vote with a hash-and-pointer to its commentary in the ADR-0004 store; commentary is payload and erasable, the
vote is not.
So the round needs no effect-stream scheme: §7 does not rest on ADR-0021.

text.tspan: What promotes, and what does not

svg.text: Promotion is a grant (§1): operational bundles, mechanism releases (including policy-floor and rules-floor changes) and Personas.
Runtime subtraction is not promotion (§9): e-stop, lease expiry, revocation and bundle(deny=all) need no quorum, are attributed, and are ordered
when they change replicated state.
Fast path for strictly subtractive bundles: deferred.

text.tspan: Quorum: archetype "all" versus a threshold k, and the two declared degeneracies

svg.text: Every counted grant seat must grant; a grant-seat deny or abstention denies.
Required by R1
A grant-vote threshold over the counted seats: D-0024-1, k-of-n
Relaxes R1; R9 keeps k ≥ 2
One signer: D-0024-2, the pre-0024 status quo
Relaxes R1, R9 and R2
Withdrawn (rev 5): it is k = 1 and tolerates no Byzantine approver, never the
k-of-n degeneracy it appeared to be
A threshold means something only with at least three counted seats: at two, k ≥ 2 is unanimity (ADR-0026 §7 finding 3).
k-of-n grant seats
No promotion without every grant seat
Tolerance of n−k Byzantine approvers
Liveness under n−k absent approvers
Single signer (the pre-0024 status
quo)
Grants need consensus
All approver fault tolerance; reintroduces a privileged human grant
Throughput

Both ratified with ADR-0024 as declarations (B2). Each is a change to issued quorum and minGrant, so it relaxes ADR-0026 entries, not this record, and needs an anchor issuance plus a promotion under the rule being replaced. A promotion degeneracy is a mechanism release;
approver fault tolerance and anchor recoverability are declared independently (ToO §7.7).

text.tspan: Stated costs, and where the record stands

svg.text: Liveness equals the availability of every grant seat, Persona and incident-driven bundle promotions included.
Liveness assumption: weak fairness on Vote for grant seats, an assumption about people.
A2 adds a second: weak fairness on an independent Observer's lease and its coverage, an assumption about a
deployment.
Correlated review failure is untouched: unanimous humans reading the same vacuous gate output fail together
(Moon & Varshney §4.6; Knight & Leveson).
Floor fitness, a fourth gate (NIST MEASURE 2.13), is still unowned.
One compromised seat is a veto until the anchor reissues the roster.
Voters are Mediated: promotion gains attribution and authorization, not safety properties.

text.tspan: Accepted · bootstrap set · A2 in force

svg.text: ADR-0024 is Accepted (genesis), 2026.09.23, at revision 5, in Batch 2.
No confirmation marker: a bootstrap record (ADR-0029 §4); confirmation runs under it. ADR-0029 A2's
full-corpus review reaches it before bootstrap: a reader, not a confirmation promotion.
A2 ratified 2026.09.29 (Batch 15), in genesis for the same reason.
In the reference: A2.1 (veto roster kinds) and A2.3 (Tally::Stalled until coverage) are in force; A2.2 is not
(G18): no independence table exists, since ADR-0035 is Proposed and §4 is unbuilt.
Owed: the ADR-0026 non-vacuity rerun with A2.2 and A2.3 as conjuncts (G7 item 39); the Promotion bootstrap
module (StaleVotesNeverCount), not drafted; independent evidence and seat diversity, candidate floor entries.

Sources: ADR-0024 §1–§9, enabling condition, Degeneracies, Consequences, Open obligations, A1, A2 (A2.1–A2.4), History B2; ADR-0026 §2 R1, R2, R5, R9, §7; ADR-0022 §1 Vote row, §7; ADR-0035 §4, §5 (Proposed); ADR-0038 §6; ADR-0039 §3; ADR-0032 §2; ADR-0029 §4, §5; ToO rev 11 §7.1, §7.7, §9; G7 §1.2, §7 items 39, 46; mechanism/GAPS-AND-ASSUMPTIONS.md G18
